description: The file defines the EntryCollection class, which is part of the LDAP DTO (Data Transfer Object) subsystem in the OrangeHRM project. It manages a collection of EntryCollectionLookupSettingPair objects, providing counting and retrieval functionalities.

classes.name: EntryCollection
classes.description: Represents a collection of EntryCollectionLookupSettingPair objects, with methods to count and access the collection.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EntryCollection with a variable number of EntryCollectionLookupSettingPair objects.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total count of entries across all contained EntryCollectionLookupSettingPair objects, caching the result for efficiency.

methods.name: getCollections
methods.description: Returns the array of contained EntryCollectionLookupSettingPair objects.
